name: KoKoRead - Roald Dahl Kids Reading Quest
description: Gamified 15-minute daily reading platform adapting Charles Dickens' masterpieces (Great Expectations, Oliver Twist, A Christmas Carol, David Copperfield, and A Tale of Two Cities) for ages 5-6, 7-8, and 9+ with KooBits rewards, quizzes, and AI Book Buddies.
